newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Gunmen steal $4.8 million at Brazilian airport.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen steal $4.8 million at Brazilian airport.

text.p: Gunmen disguised as airport workers stole about $4.8 million as it was unloaded from a passenger jet at Rio's International Airport, an airport spokesman said on Saturday.
The bags of money had arrived on Friday evening from the southern town of Foz de Iguacu and had been unloaded onto the airport apron ready to be picked up by a security car.
The gang arrived in a van with the airline's logo, loaded up the haul and drove off with the security guard who had been travelling with the money. He was later released.
The whole hoist lasted less than 20 minutes and, although the security guard said the gang of around 10 men was heavily armed, not a shot was fired.
Airport and police authorities are investigating how the thieves entered the airport unchallenged, the spokesman said.
